newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura share of TSE trade slips further - Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Nomura share of TSE trade slips further - Kyodo.

text.p: Scandal-hit Nomura Securities Co Ltd suffered a further drop in its share of combined stock trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) in June, Kyodo news agency reported on Wednesday.

In the midst of a widening payoff scandal linking it to a corporate racketeer, Nomura's share of stock trade slid to 5.76 percent from May's 6.42 percent, the smallest among Japan's "Big Four" brokerages, Kyodo reported, quoting industry officials.

With a 9.64 percent share, Daiwa Securities Co Ltd 8601 T retained its top position on the TSE for the fourth consecutive month, after Nomura fell from the industry pinnacle for the first time ever in March, Kyodo said.
Daiwa was followed by Nikko Securities Co Ltd, which commanded an 8.31 percent share, and Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd with a 6.03 percent share, it said.
No brokerage officials were immediately available for comment on the report. -- Tokyo Equities Desk +81-3-3432-9404
